rules.name: Immediate Order Locking on Failure
rules.statement: The system must immediately release all stock locks associated with an Order Request upon detection of a system outage or data corruption event.
rules.condition: when a system failure or data corruption is detected during order preparation or allocation
exceptions: manual override by a senior operations manager for high-value orders
rules.if_violated: The business risks overselling inventory, causing order fulfillment failures, and incurring regulatory penalties for inaccurate stock reporting.
rules.rationale: Preventing error propagation ensures that corrupted data does not lead to double-booking of perishable goods during critical outages.

parameters.name: outage_detection_threshold
parameters.description: the latency or error rate trigger that defines a system failure

rules.name: Strict Identity-Contact Consistency
rules.statement: A Customer Profile must not be activated if the provided contact details do not exactly match the verified identity document.
rules.condition: during the Customer Profile activation process
rules.if_violated: The business faces regulatory non-compliance risks and potential fraud due to unverified user identities.
rules.rationale: Ensuring data integrity and regulatory adherence by preventing activation of profiles with inconsistent identity information.

parameters.name: verification_tolerance_level
parameters.description: the allowable character difference for name/address matching (proposed)

rules.name: Immutable Audit Trail for Settlements
rules.statement: Every Financial Transaction Record and Settlement event must generate an immutable audit trail that cannot be altered or deleted.
rules.condition: for every financial transaction and settlement event
rules.if_violated: The business loses the ability to prove compliance during audits, risking severe legal penalties and loss of trust.
rules.rationale: Maintaining an unchangeable record of financial movements is essential for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.

parameters.name: retention_period
parameters.description: the minimum legal requirement duration for the operating zone (proposed)

rules.name: Perishable Priority Allocation
rules.statement: Perishable items must be prioritized for allocation to Order Requests based on their proximity to the expiration date.
rules.condition: when allocating stock to multiple concurrent Order Requests
exceptions: manual override by store manager for high-margin non-perishable substitution
rules.if_violated: The business incurs increased waste costs and potential food safety violations due to expired goods being sold.
rules.rationale: Minimizing waste and ensuring food safety by selling items closest to expiration first.

parameters.name: expiration_priority_weight
parameters.description: the factor determining priority based on days remaining (proposed)
